title: [P1] ProductDetails: Clicking product name on inventory navigates to product details page
conditions: User is on the inventory page (/inventory.html)
ideas: Observe the inventory page listing all 6 products with clickable name links
Locate the product name link 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
Click the product name link 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
Observe that navigation occurs to the product details page
verifications: Inventory page is loaded and displays multiple product name links
'Sauce Labs Backpack' name link is visible and cursor is pointer
URL changes to /inventory-item.html and the product details page for 'Sauce Labs Backpack' is displayed
ac_trace: AC1: Given a user is on the inventory page, when they click on a product name or product image, they are navigated to the dedicated product details page
